title: Investigate missing 50 services in systemd service enumeration
description:
The services resource returns 280 out of 330 services on Fedora test VM. Need to identify why 50 services are missing:
- Current status: Template units (@.service) are filtered out
- Batching in groups of 15 (systemctl show hard limit)
- Possible causes: masked services, aliases, or services that fail systemctl show queries
- Goal: Determine if we can get closer to 100% coverage or if 85% is acceptable

title: Implement plural services resource for InSpec
description: Create a new services resource that can enumerate and filter all services on a system, complementing the existing singular service resource. This is a FilterTable-based plural resource similar to users, processes, etc.

title: Core implementation of services resource
description: ✅ COMPLETED: lib/inspec/resources/services.rb - Full FilterTable integration with 8 columns (names, descriptions, types, enabled, running, installed, startmodes, startnames). Custom matchers (exists?, enabled?, running?, installed?). Platform-specific service managers for Systemd, SysV, Upstart, Windows, macOS, FreeBSD, AIX, Solaris. Caching and error handling implemented.
close_reason: Implementation complete with all platform managers and FilterTable integration
